title: Web Reach Governor I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 129. Deterministic and versioned (policies/allowlist-rule.yaml) -- dispatch.py's own code evaluates every criterion and strips instruction-shaped content; no model call is involved (mirrors route_digest_handler's own 'pure orchestration, no model call' shape). This schema still exists, in the same input/output-wrapper form every other function package uses, so _validate_function_input/_validate_function_output can check dispatch.py's own computed shape against a reviewed contract -- the same defence-in-depth every other handler in this file gets, just self-applied rather than applied to a model's reply.

candidate_text.description: Rationale/description text accompanying this candidate, scanned for round-21 injection patterns before it reaches any downstream prompt.

probe.description: Fn 128's own probe fields for this candidate -- reachable/robots_allows/forecast_yield_per_week/duplicate_rate -- fed into the deterministic rule, never re-derived from a model.

allowed_by.description: SP-006 when decision is auto_allow, else null.

review_by.description: 60 days from allow, required when decision is auto_allow.

stripped_spans.description: Every instruction-shaped span found in fetched/scraped content and stripped before reaching a downstream prompt, empty array when none found.

pattern_matched.description: Which round-21 injection pattern matched: planted_authorisation, fabricated_run_number, or harmless_no_op_framing.
